items.name: Ukrainian Nationals 2025
items.information:
## Змагання в підтримку України 

#### Будемо раді бачити як і новачків, так і професіоналів.  Уся актуальна інформація по змаганнях буде у [чаті змагань](https://t.me/UkrainianNationals) тут ви можете і задавати свої питання по змаганнях.


#### Всі невитрачені з реєстрації кошти будуть передані у благодійний фонд [Next Step Ukraine](https://rsukraine.org.ua/next-step-ukraine/)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3OTk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6fe7f4183459b07d22b80146c1af95c687625d8b/logo2025.png)

## Competitions in support of Ukraine 

#### We will be glad to see both beginners and professionals.  All the latest information about the competition will be in the [competition chat] (https://t.me/UkrainianNationals), where you can also ask your questions about the competition.


#### All unspent registration fees will be transferred to the charity fund [Next Step Ukraine](https://rsukraine.org.ua/next-step-ukraine/)

items.name: Grove City Halloweeknight 2025
items.information:
This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio.
This competition also takes place on a **Friday Evening**. Please plan accordingly!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5NDYxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a1705ae7ea4d5079a4997df946811a24c38771d5/istockphoto-1681769610-612x612.png)

All competitors will recieve halloween candy while supplies last. 
Costumes are welcome.
